test.query: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT if(number % 2, number % 30000000, rand() % 80000) FROM numbers_mt(100000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT number % 20000000, number % 15000000 FROM numbers_mt(80000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT if(number % 10 > 0, number, rand() % 30000), materialize('string') FROM numbers_mt(20000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT toString(if(number % 2, number % 30000000, rand() % 80000)) FROM numbers_mt(50000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM (SELECT DISTINCT toString(number % 5000000), toString(rand() % 100000) FROM numbers_mt(50000000)) FORMAT Null
